relationships.subject: aqueous chlorhexidine
relationships.evidence_quote: Topical AqCHX has similar efficacy to PI for the prevention of endophthalmitis after IVI.

key_findings: Endophthalmitis incidence after intravitreal anti-VEGF injection was low and did not differ between povidone-iodine (0.022%) and aqueous chlorhexidine (0.014%) antisepsis.
